human_intent: Estate-wide tailnet access is intended for qualified shared non-Matter SKGateway (profile 6073417e). This ingress provides controlled, supervised access across the estate tailnet while preserving the exact loopback backend profile.

acceptance_criteria.1: Ingress binds only chiap01 Tailscale IPv4 100.80.180.78 on port 28880 and tailscale0, never wildcard, LAN, public, dashboard, or metrics; backend stays 127.0.0.1:28880 with exact profile 6073417e.
acceptance_criteria.2: Use a root-owned hardened supervised socket/proxy unit or equivalently narrow mechanism with exact hashes, no inline credential, Tailscale identity boundary, connection and restart limits, and disabled-by-default installation before qualification.
acceptance_criteria.3: Qualify access from chiap08 and denial or absence on non-tailnet interfaces; health, catalog, chat, SSE, tools, attribution, capacity, cancellation, backend outage, proxy restart, gateway restart, leakage, and audit pass with public synthetic traffic only.
acceptance_criteria.4: Existing 18790 remains rollback and protected SKLegal/OpenRouter remain excluded; rollback disables/removes only ingress and shared unit and proves 28880 closed on tailnet and loopback.

rollback.command: systemctl disable --now skgateway-shared-tailnet.socket skgateway-shared-tailnet.service skgateway-shared-shadow.service && rm -f /etc/systemd/system/skgateway-shared-tailnet.* /etc/sklegal/skgateway/shared-shadow.yaml*
